section13_checks.prohibition_description: Treating Grant Agreement Annex templates as the governing structural schema for proposal writing.
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes, or expected impacts not present in Tier 2B.
Inventing project facts — partner names, capabilities, roles, budget figures — not present in Tier 3.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: The artifact grounds the gate pass on a budget source explicitly labelled fictional: "budget_response_reference": "budget_response_FICTIONAL_demo_2026-10-01.json" and "validation_artifact_reference": "budget_validation_response_2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.json". All wp_coverage_results and partner_coverage_results (WP1–WP7, P01–P12) resolve budget figures via "received/budget_response_FICTIONAL_demo_2026-10-01.json#...". The artifact carries no traceability_footer referencing docs/tier3_project_instantiation/, and the budget source is a fabricated ('FICTIONAL') response rather than a received, validated external planner budget. A budget figure source so named is an invented budget figure under §13.3 (and contravenes §8.3/§17.6.7 on fabricated/substituted budget figures).

section13_checks.prohibition_description: Commencing any Phase 8 activity before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed.
Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
Allowing a workflow or skill to become a de facto constitutional authority.
Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions when inputs are incomplete.
Finalizing proposal text when source state is incomplete without flagging the gap.
Using agent-local knowledge of Horizon Europe rules as a substitute for Tier 1 source documents.
Producing Tier 5 outputs not traceable to specific inputs in Tier 1–4.
Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project assumptions.
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.

decision_log_entries.resolution_note: Constitutional violation detected; requires human operator resolution. The Phase 7 budget gate declares gate_pass_declaration: 'pass' on a budget source explicitly named 'budget_response_FICTIONAL_demo_2026-10-01.json'. This is a fabricated budget figure under §13.3 and is not a validated external planner response under §8.3/§17.6.7. If an in-session §1 human override suspending §13.3 was in force when this artifact was produced, that override is not present in this skill's audit context and cannot be assumed; the operator must confirm or reject it.
